title: Fix Incoming Documents default processed filter
summary: The Incoming Documents page now defaults to showing only unprocessed records when opened without a filter, while preserving explicit filter choices. This restores the expected behavior after a regression.
key_points: Default view shows unprocessed documents (Processed = false) when page opens without a filter
Explicitly applied filters (both true and false) are now preserved instead of being cleared
Regression tests added to verify all three filter scenarios work correctly
No impact on data, permissions, or upgrade process
